timestamps.description: Initial reveal of the completed interactive dashboard showcasing various charts and KPIs.
The left side panel of the dashboard is populated with dynamic KPI values, including orders, quantity, and revenue, along with descriptive icons.
The trend line chart and a heat map for purchase patterns are added and formatted into the main dashboard area.
All charts, including geographical maps, quantity distribution, popular products, shipping duration, and customer satisfaction, are integrated, and interactive slicers are connected.
The fully polished and interactive dashboard is displayed with clear titles, consistent formatting, and a unified corporate color scheme.
